topics.title: AI capabilities depend on toolkits, not inherent intelligence

claims.text: AI systems are not inherently intelligent; their complex abilities come from toolkits, ready examples, and external modules.
Toolkits can provide a large performance boost but cannot fully compensate for a model's missing basic abilities.
Older models were trained on everything without clear purpose, while modern models aim to achieve more with fewer parameters and sometimes are fine‑tuned for specific tasks.
P1 observed strange people on a bus, staying idle and later encountering the same person who emitted gas.
P4 shared a link with a pin, and later expressed hope that it is still relevant.
Participants debated the price of diploma covers, mentioning 650 UAH from Bogdan, 30 UAH from others, and personal payments of 47 UAH.
P1 suggested getting the diploma without a cover since it is essentially waste paper.
P8 argued the cover bears the university emblem, making it unique, but later claimed nobody will keep it and it will be seen only three times in a lifetime.

topics.title: Fitting multiple GPUs into a small PC case

claims.text: A small PC case that normally holds one small GPU can be modified with straps and force to accommodate three GPUs.
